import hashlib,json,re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('products/services/catalogue-qa-digital-checkout')
sources={}
quote='Lemon Squeezy is no longer accepting new sign-ups and will shut down on March 31, 2027'
for slug,filename in [('activate-your-store','store-activation'),('prohibited-products','prohibited-products'),('supported-countries','supported-countries'),('fees','fees')]:
    path=p/'raw'/(filename+'.html')
    raw=path.read_bytes()
    sources[filename]={'path':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'url':'https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/help/getting-started/'+slug,'exact_shutdown_banner_present':quote in raw.decode('utf-8')}
assert sources['prohibited-products']['exact_shutdown_banner_present']
assert sources['store-activation']['exact_shutdown_banner_present']
candidate=Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example/verify_example.py')
result={'decision':'STOP_NEW_SELLER_ROUTE','controlling_quotation':quote,'sources':sources,'candidate':{'path':str(candidate),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'scope':'Existing runnable QA example using companion verifier and synthetic CSV fixtures. A self-serve download is distinct from the email service. Paid redistribution rights were not established.'},'conditions':{'country':'Saved supported-country documentation lists Canada for bank payouts. This does not grant seller onboarding or establish a payout method for GlobalLand.','product':'Saved product rules generally permit digital goods fulfilled on-site and prohibit services of any kind. Specific AI-produced artifact approval remains unverified.','fees':'Saved fee example shows USD 0.50 plus 5% of total order value and an additional international fee in its example. Upfront or recurring charges and actual payout costs for this seller were not established.','marketplace':'The generic help index is insufficient for admission or discoverability.','account':'No eligible existing store was evidenced. New signup is explicitly closed. The documented shutdown also limits any grandfathered route.'},'commercial_decision':'Do not prepare a listing or extrapolate hypothetical proceeds for this closed signup route. A successor platform requires its own evidence.','observed_orders_or_revenue':None}
dest=p/'checkout-verdict.json'
dest.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.loads(dest.read_text())['decision'])
